kmimic.Description: A comprehensive clinical database covering patients admitted to the ICU, spanning their entire hospitalization from admission to discharge. It includes demographic and admission records, hospital-wide diagnoses, procedures, laboratory and prescription data, high-resolution ICU monitoring and interventions, emergency department encounters with triage and medication history, as well as institutional hospital information.

admissions.Description: Information about a patient’s admission, discharge, admission types/locations, and mortality indicators.

subject_id.description: Unique patient identifier; links to PATIENTS.

hadm_id.description: Unique identifier for a hospital admission.

admittime.description: Date and time registered for admission.

dischtime.description: Date and time registered for discharge.

deathtime.description: Date and time of patient's death (if applicable).

admission_type.description: Type of admission (e.g., Emergency department, Outpatient department, Admission, Neonate).

admission_location.description: Patient’s location before arrival (e.g., last ER location; otherwise NULL).

discharge_location.description: Patient’s location after discharge (home, nursing home, other hospital, died, etc.).

marital_status.description: Patient’s current marital status (e.g., married, single, widowed, etc.).

edregtime.description: ER arrival date/time for admissions via the ER.

edouttime.description: ER discharge date/time for admissions via the ER.

icu_expire_flag.description: ICU mortality indicator (1=expired during ICU stay, 0=otherwise).

patients.Description: Demographics consistent across a patient’s lifetime; includes gender, de-identified age/year anchors, and death date (if present).

anchor_age.description: Patient age at time of admission; unit varies (days/months/years, with 90+ capped).

anchor_year_group.description: Year group categorized by actual admission year.

transfers.Description: Detailed unit/ward transfer timeline across the hospital stay.

subject_id.description: Unique patient identifier; links to PATIENTS.

transfer_seq.description: Sequence number for each movement in chronological order.

transfer_id.description: Unique key for each movement (HADM_ID + TRANSFER_SEQ).

diagnoses_icd.Description: ICD diagnoses associated with hospitalizations; includes sequence within ICU context and ICU-origin flag.

subject_id.description: Unique patient identifier; links to PATIENTS.

seq_num.description: Sequence number for ICU-related diagnoses (main, date, name ordering).

itemid.description: Local diagnosis code used by the institution.

is_icu.description: Whether diagnosis issued by treating ICU department (Y/N).

edi_code.description: Insurance EDI code (or KMM90000 when not billed).
Insurance EDI code (KMM90000 if not billed).

event_txt.description: Outcome/status (Administered / Not given / Held / Finished etc.).

itemid.description: Medication code; links to PRESCRIPTIONS.itemid where applicable.

stay_id.description: ICU stay ID if order occurred during ICU stay; else NULL.

emar_detail.Description: Per-administration details including notes, on/off flags, and infusion rates.

subject_id.description: Unique patient identifier; links to PATIENTS.

parent_field_ordinal.description: Sequence per prescription (within a drug bundle).

labevents.Description: Results of laboratory measurements (hematology, chemistry, blood gas, etc.).

subject_id.description: Unique patient identifier; links to PATIENTS.

itemid.description: Lab test code; links to D_LABITEMS.

charttime.description: Time point representing the patient’s state for the result (e.g., specimen collection time).

stay_id.description: ICU stay ID if ordered during an ICU stay; else NULL.

stay_id.description: ICU stay ID if ordered during ICU stay; else NULL.

prod_strength.description: Dose/frequency/duration text at time of order.

stay_id.description: ICU stay ID if ordered during ICU stay; else NULL.

procedures_icd.Description: ICD-coded procedures and surgery scheduling context.

subject_id.description: Unique patient identifier; links to PATIENTS.

stay_id.description: ICU stay ID if within ICU period; else NULL.
